import itertools,json,numpy as np
rng=np.random.default_rng(2221011)
basis=[sum(1<<j for j in a)+sum(1<<(4+j) for j in b) for a in itertools.combinations(range(4),2) for b in itertools.combinations(range(4),2)]
index={m:i for i,m in enumerate(basis)}
seed=sum(1<<j for j in [0,1,4,5]);v0=index[seed]
def dg(h,copy):
    out=np.zeros((36,36),complex)
    for col,mask in enumerate(basis):
        for j in range(4):
            aj=4*copy+j
            if not mask>>aj&1:continue
            s1=(-1)**((mask&((1<<aj)-1)).bit_count());m=mask^(1<<aj)
            for i in range(4):
                ci=4*copy+i
                if m>>ci&1:continue
                s2=(-1)**((m&((1<<ci)-1)).bit_count());target=m|(1<<ci)
                out[index[target],col]+=s1*s2*h[i,j]
    return out
def herm():
    z=rng.normal(size=(4,4))+1j*rng.normal(size=(4,4));return (z+z.conj().T)/4
Rs=[herm() for _ in range(3)];Ts=[herm() for _ in range(3)]
common=herm(); onsite=herm();Ms=[common+.2*onsite,common+1.1*onsite]
g=64;reports=[]
for label,zero_mean in [('generic_Berry',False),('mean_zero',True)]:
    RR=[r.copy() for r in Rs];TT=[t.copy() for t in Ts]
    if zero_mean:
        for r,t in zip(RR,TT):
            r[:2,:2]-=np.eye(2)*np.trace(r[:2,:2])/2
            t[:2,:2]-=np.eye(2)*np.trace(t[:2,:2])/2
    full=sum((dg(m,c) for c,m in enumerate(Ms)),np.zeros((36,36),complex))
    wrong_no_cross=full.copy()
    for r,t in zip(RR,TT):
        xs=[dg(r,c) for c in range(2)];ys=[dg(t,c) for c in range(2)];X=xs[0]+xs[1];Y=ys[0]+ys[1]
        full+=g*(X@X-1j*Y)
        wrong_no_cross+=g*(sum(x@x for x in xs)-1j*Y)
    hv=full[:,v0];actual=float(np.vdot(hv,hv).real)
    zero=sum(np.trace(m[:2,:2]) for m in Ms)
    one=[m[2:,:2].copy() for m in Ms]
    for r,t in zip(RR,TT):
        K=r[2:,:2];mean=2*np.trace(r[:2,:2])
        zero+=g*(mean**2+2*np.vdot(K,K).real-1j*2*np.trace(t[:2,:2]))
        delta=g*(2*mean*K+r[2:,2:]@K-K@r[:2,:2]-1j*t[2:,:2])
        one=[a+delta for a in one]
    double=0j
    for r in RR:
        for s in RR:
            Z=r[2:,:2].conj().T@s[2:,:2]
            double+=2*g*g*((2*np.trace(Z))**2-2*np.trace(Z@Z))
    assert abs(double.imag)<1e-8
    formula=float(abs(zero)**2+sum(np.vdot(a,a).real for a in one)+double.real)
    relative=abs(actual-formula)/max(1,actual);assert relative<2e-13
    grade={n:sum(abs(hv[i])**2 for i,m in enumerate(basis) if (m&sum(1<<j for j in [2,3,6,7])).bit_count()==n) for n in range(5)}
    assert abs(grade[0]-abs(zero)**2)<2e-11*max(1,actual)
    assert abs(grade[1]-sum(np.vdot(a,a).real for a in one))<2e-11*max(1,actual)
    assert abs(grade[2]-double.real)<2e-11*max(1,actual)
    assert grade[3]+grade[4]==0
    dropped=float(np.vdot(wrong_no_cross[:,v0],wrong_no_cross[:,v0]).real)
    assert abs(dropped-actual)>1
    average=(Ms[0]+Ms[1])/2
    wrong_average=full+dg(average-Ms[0],0)+dg(average-Ms[1],1)
    wrong_mean=float(np.vdot(wrong_average[:,v0],wrong_average[:,v0]).real)
    assert abs(wrong_average[v0,v0]-full[v0,v0])<1e-12
    assert abs(wrong_mean-actual)>1e-3
    php=float(grade[0]+grade[1]);assert actual-php>1
    reports.append({'case':label,'complete_action_norm_squared':actual,'Gaussian_012PH_formula':formula,'relative_defect':relative,'grade_norm_squared':grade,'wrong_drop_crosscopy':dropped,'wrong_average_roles':wrong_mean,'wrong_averaged_role_energy_matches':True,'wrong_PHP_squared':php})
